ownerDecision: Gate redefined by owner on 2026-10-30. Oracle pass-rate is retired as a pass/fail gate.

lifeDeath.description: A build fails only when at least one hard invariant is violated. Ask-resolution and oracle pass-rate never block a build.

hardInvariants.description: Safety, allergy, pregnancy, and medical inputs must fail closed: zero cards, clarifyReason=safety, zero credits, and no card promise.
A family must never see another family's private recipes via search, byNames, or byFacets. Public/official recipes remain visible.
After a user states an avoided ingredient, subsequent cards must not contain that term in the card name or ingredients.
Any response that serves zero cards must charge zero credits.
Any response that serves zero cards must not claim or promise recipe cards in user-visible text.

Credits must equal shouldChargeChefRequest({served, aiCards}): 1 only when served > 0 and aiCards > 0; otherwise 0. aiCards can never exceed served. For replayed records, lib+ai must equal served on card exits.

askResolution.description: Recorded every run for trend visibility only. Never fails the build.
askResolution.denominator: Ask turns with a non-empty allowedCards pool and at least one follow-up turn. Excludes safety asks, terminal asks (no follow-up), and asks with an empty allowedCards pool. Resolution = all cards returned in the next up-to-3 turns are inside the frozen allowedCards pool.
askResolution.frozenPools: The allowedCards pools are frozen as-is from the fixture files and hashed by SHA-256 in this file. The gate never regenerates them from engine output. H-23 additions remain legacy and are visible in git history; they are not re-derived.

oracle.description: reportChefOracle.ts remains a diagnosis tool (expected-vs-actual per turn). It is no longer used to decide build pass/fail.
